notes:
The SAM Codes & Schools window now has copy-ready queries that pull everything from SAM.

One query for everything (fastest): a new bar at the top of the window has Copy the all-in-one query.

Paste it into SAM under Ad Hoc Query > Query and click Run Query.
Save the results as sam_all_codes.csv.
Click Import CSV files and choose that file.

That fills in all 10 lists in one go: schools with their SchoolID, school code and short name, plus grade levels, enrollment status, gender, race, owner types, contact relationships, phone types, roster status and attendance codes. The owner-type and enrolled-student codes in District Settings then fill in automatically.

One query per list (backup): each list in the window now has its own row of buttons:

Copy query
Show query, which displays the SQL
Import this list
The row also shows the file name to save the results as.

These are there in case your SAM is missing one of the code tables and the all-in-one query errors.

Also added:

Save all queries to a folder: writes the all-in-one query, the 10 separate queries and a READ ME that lists the file names.
Load from SAM: if the read-only SAM connection is turned on, this fills the lists directly with no copying or CSV files.
The setup wizard’s codes step now uses the all-in-one query too.

data.notes: Initial table catalog, starter templates, 52 platform export packages with checking rules, data cleanup reports, SAM setup check, shared package library and Query Assistant vocabulary.
